studentPrompt: A garden bed is divided into two equal halves. One half has vegetables. One fourth of that vegetable half is planted with carrots. Draw a whole-bed rectangle, partition and shade the carrot area, then explain what fraction of the entire bed is carrots.
answerForTeacher: 1/8 of the original whole garden bed.

rubric.criterion: represents the original entire garden bed
shows two equal halves and selects vegetable half
partitions selected half into four equal parts and shades one
explains shaded part as 1/8 of original full bed, not 1/4 of full bed

acceptance: equivalent rotated, subdivided, or rearranged equal-area model earns credit; numerical answer without a justified diagram cannot earn full credit
